items.title: Return completed accident questionnaire
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns den ausgefüllten Fragebogen innerhalb von 10 Arbeitstagen (Montag bis Freitag, ohne Feiertage) nach dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: Period is set as 10 Arbeitstage (Mon-Fri, excluding public holidays) 'nach dem Briefdatum' (after the letter date), not after receipt. Letter date is 06.05.2026 (Wednesday). Per §187 Abs. 1 BGB, since an event (the letter date) triggers the period, that day itself is not counted, so counting starts the next day, 07.05.2026 (Thursday) = working day 1. Counting only Mon-Fri and skipping the NRW public holiday of Christi Himmelfahrt (Ascension Day), which falls on 14.05.2026 (Easter Sunday 05.04.2026 + 39 days): day1=Thu 07.05, day2=Fri 08.05, (weekend 09-10.05 skipped), day3=Mon 11.05, day4=Tue 12.05, day5=Wed 13.05, (14.05 Thu is Christi Himmelfahrt, a holiday, skipped), day6=Fri 15.05, (weekend 16-17.05 skipped), day7=Mon 18.05, day8=Tue 19.05, day9=Wed 20.05, day10=Thu 21.05.2026. The 10th working day, 21.05.2026, is itself a normal working day (Thursday, not a weekend or holiday), so no further shift is needed.
